verdict.rationale: Elastic documents native OpenTelemetry ingestion, vendor-neutral instrumentation without proprietary agents, and EDOT with 'no vendor lock-in'. Together these support the 'instrument once with open standards' half of the story. The 'switch backends without re-instrumenting' half is only implied by marketing claims. missing for 10: documentation showing EDOT/OTel instrumentation exported to or migrated between non-Elastic backends without code changes, any limits of EDOT versus upstream OTel, and independent or hands-on corroboration of portability.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument once with open standards and switch backends without re-instrumenting my code

citations.quote: This allows organizations to use vendor-neutral instrumentation and stream native OTel data without proprietary agents, leveraging Elastic OpenTelemetry.
Elastic Distributions of OpenTelemetry (EDOT) delivers production-ready collection with no vendor lock-in.
built on OpenTelemetry (OTel) from the ground up
Ingest metrics from any source using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus remote write
embraces open standards like OpenTelemetry for flexible data collection
